page_title: ECU 1-2 SEN | Ecuador v Senegal 29/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+5' That's the end of the game for Boulaye Dia, who is replaced by Pape Abou Cisse (Senegal).
90+5' Clement Turpin blows his whistle as Piero Hincapie (Ecuador) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+4' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+3' A corner kick by Ecuador is thwarted by the well prepared Edouard Mendy (Senegal). The ball is out of play and Ecuador manage to earn a corner.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Jose Adoni Cifuentes Charcopa (Ecuador) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Ecuador will take a corner kick.
90+1' Clement Turpin blows his whistle. Jackson Gabriel Porozo Vernaza (Ecuador) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Edouard Mendy pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

88' Pape Gueye (Senegal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Hernan Galindez has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
88' The game is interrupted. Piero Hincapie (Ecuador) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
86' Nampalys Mendy (Senegal) brings his opponent down. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
85' A substitution has been made. Angelo Preciado goes off and Jackson Gabriel Porozo Vernaza (Ecuador) comes on.
85' Dangerous play by Boulaye Dia (Senegal). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
82' The attendance for today's match is 44569.
79' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
78' The corner from Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) is cleared away by the defence.
78' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Senegal have been awarded a corner kick.

76' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Edouard Mendy guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Bamba Dieng (Senegal) is brought on as a substitute for Iliman Ndiaye.
74' Aliou Cisse prepares a substitution. Pathe Ciss is replaced by Nampalys Mendy (Senegal).
74' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) is moving okay again after that injury scare. Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
70' 1 - 2 Goal! Kalidou Koulibaly (Senegal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:2.

70' Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Senegal.
68' Felix Torres (Ecuador) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
67' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Felix Torres knock down. 1:1.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ecuador, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Ecuador can continue in their attacking effort.
66' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Idrissa Gueye (Senegal), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
64' Substitution. Djorkaeff Reasco (Ecuador) in, Michael Estrada out.
63' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
62' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jose Adoni Cifuentes Charcopa (Ecuador).
61' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
61' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Senegal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
59' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
58' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
57' Great teamplay by Ecuador as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
52' Clement Turpin blows the whistle, Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador) is penalised for a foul.
51' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
50' Poor challenge! Pathe Ciss (Senegal) is penalised for tripping and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.

49' Jose Adoni Cifuentes Charcopa (Ecuador) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Edouard Mendy pulls off an easy save.
47' Pathe Ciss (Senegal) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
46' Gustavo Alfaro makes a switch. Jeremy Sarmiento is coming on in place of Alan Franco (Ecuador) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Carlos Gruezo (Ecuador) is replaced by Jose Adoni Cifuentes Charcopa.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' A cross by Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45+5' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+3' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+2' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. Now Senegal have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Hernan Galindez into the bottom right corner.
43' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is going to take the penalty!
42' Piero Hincapie (Ecuador) brings an opponent down and Clement Turpin interrupts the game. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Senegal!
42' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
41' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) is adjudged offside.
40' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) is able to continue to play.
39' Looks like Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
38' Youssouf Sabaly nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Ismaila Sarr (Senegal), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.

37' What an opportunity! Pathe Ciss (Senegal) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
36' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
36' Hernan Galindez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Boulaye Dia (Senegal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
35' 2:9 – the total goal attempt statistics. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:3.
32' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Idrissa Gueye (Senegal).

29' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Hernan Galindez to make a comfortable save.

27' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
26' Abdou Diallo (Senegal) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
25' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
25' The resulting corner from Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) comes to nothing.
24' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Senegal are awarded a corner kick.
22' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Clement Turpin blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) sends the corner into the box, but Hernan Galindez intercepts it and averts the threat.
18' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Senegal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
15' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
15' Pape Gueye (Senegal) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Hernan Galindez makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
14' A long ball forward to Enner Valencia (Ecuador) is intercepted.
12' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.
11' The corner from Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) is intercepted by Hernan Galindez.
11' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) hammered the ball from a long-range free kick only into the defensive wall.
9' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Ecuador get a free kick.
8' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
7' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Senegal.
4' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is flagged for offside.

3' Good chance! Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Ecuador will have a goal kick.
1' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Ecuador will kick the game off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
